title: At least one team has called Steelers about Joey Porter Jr.

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: At least one team has called Steelers about Joey Porter Jr.
sources.description: Friday's deep dive from ESPN into the far-simpler-than-it-seems contract issue between the Steelers and cornerback Joey Porter Jr. included a contention that the team has not received any "serious inquiries" regarding a trade.
